caption: The drawing depicts a pedestal-like object with a square top surface and a broad, sturdy base. The sides of the pedestal curve inward, forming an hourglass shape, and are decorated with circular moldings. The central feature on the side facing the viewer is a circular medallion with a flower-like design in the middle, comprised of a starburst of petal shapes radiating from a central point. The object is primarily colored in shades of pinkish-red, simulated to resemble marble or another stone material, with accents and edges rendered in brown and beige that suggest wood or bronze details. The base consists of multiple stepped layers, each portrayed in varying shades of brown. The drawing is set against a plain, unadorned off-white background, and in the lower right corner, the name "Edward T. Jewett" is written in small text.
title: Stand for Baptismal Font
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
